Alex G.: heads-up — main turned red ~5m after the automerge. gpu-smoke failed, looks noisy. pinging @oncall and @maria
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline failed on branch `main` (job: gpu-smoke, matrix: batch=32). logs: https://ci.internal/runs/12345 · triggered by PR #1987 merge
Maria S.: grabbing logs now, will scan for obvious regressions
Alex G.: last merge was from @Sam K., fyi
Sam K.: that was my PR (allocator fallback change). I'll try to reproduce locally on a small matrix
Lina T.: can someone kick a rerun? I don't have trial permissions for that queue today
Alex G.: @ci-bot /rerun run-id=12345 (attempting)
ci-bot: rerun queued (requestor: Alex G.) · job rerun id 12345-2
ci-bot: rerun finished — gpu-smoke still failing (same step)
Lina T.: attached tail of failing test from the rerun:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 0 but got 1
tests/smoke/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_eviction[batch32]
  File "tests/smoke/test_kv_cache.py", line 88, in test_prefix_eviction
    assert evictions == 0
````
Maria S.: hmm looks like KV eviction assert, flaky but reproducible here. Sam, does your allocator change touch eviction heuristics?
Sam K.: it tweaks fallback ordering, shouldn't change logical eviction counts — but kernel ordering could differ. i'll bisect my commits in the PR locally (start with dfs revert of allocator patch)
Alex G.: if bisect shows it's from the PR, recommend revert + hotfix until we have a fix. any objections?
Maria S.: no objections — no prod impact, purely CI blocking. prefer bisect first, revert if bisect points to PR
Sam K.: starting local bisect now, will post results in ~20m. logging commands: `git bisect start HEAD~5 -- bad HEAD -- good HEAD~5` then run smoke matrix locally
oncall-bot: escalation triggered — main CI red for >10m. paging oncall rotation.
Lina T.: putting the rerun logs here: https://ci.internal/runs/12345/logs/outlined/ (contains core dump links and stdout)
Maria S.: digging into trace, sending short snippet in a bit
Alex G.: thanks — keep updates here. if someone needs me to flip a revert PR I can do that quickly
Sam K.: will update with bisect outcome. if I can't repro locally, I'll ask for a core dump to be uploaded from the failing job
Maria S.: in case it helps, I see a nondeterministic seed in the test header (seed=17832). could try pinning seed to reproduce consistently
Alex G.: good note. ok team — stand by for bisect result or revert decision. :thumbsup:
